# Abdullah S. Hajjad

Official professional profile: https://ahajjad-rgb.github.io/

Abdullah S. Hajjad is a Saudi healthcare executive focused on hospital leadership, hospital operations, strategic execution, patient experience, healthcare quality, patient safety, and patient flow.

## Education
- Master's Degree in Management of Health Services — University of Bisha
- Bachelor of Science in Health Services and Hospital Management — King Abdulaziz University
- CareLead Program for Hospital Directors — delivered in collaboration with Health Holding Company and IESE Business School, 2026
